name: image_search
description: Search the web for images and return direct image URLs. Automatically fails over across image-capable providers (DuckDuckGo, SearXNG, Brave, Google CSE). Use this when the user asks to find, download, or see pictures of a specific topic.
short_description: Multi-provider image search with automatic failover returning direct image URLs.
store_description: Built-in image search tool that dispatches through SearchProviderFactory to automatically select an image-capable provider (DuckDuckGo, SearXNG, Brave, or Google CSE) with first-success failover. Returns direct image URLs plus thumbnails, source pages, and dimensions for each result.

ar.short_description: Real-time image search returning direct image URLs.

examples.output_preview: Top 3 direct image URLs for Saint Petersburg with thumbnails and source pages.
Default result count resolved from search.image_search.default_max_results; provider selected automatically with failover.

usage_notes: Prefer passing only `query`. Omit `max_results` to inherit PELDRUN Search Settings (search.image_search.default_max_results). Non-image-capable providers (Tavily, Jina, Yandex) are automatically skipped in the image provider chain. The configured provider ceiling and provider capability maximum are always enforced.

query.description: Search query string to look up images on the web.

max_results.description: Optional desired maximum number of image results. Omit this argument to inherit PELDRUN Search Settings (search.image_search.default_max_results). The configured provider ceiling and provider capability maximum are always enforced.
